newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Czech president Havel meets Brazil's Cardoso.
newsitem.headline: Czech president Havel meets Brazil's Cardoso.

text.p: Czech Republic President Vaclav Havel met Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso in Brasilia on Monday at the start of a week-long visit to Latin America's largest country.

Officials said talks between both presidents were expected to focus on bilateral trade and investment. But, despite the official emphasis on commerce, Havel's agenda is full of cultural and offbeat engagements.
The first Czech president to visit Latin America, he is scheduled to travel to the Amazon rain forest on Tuesday and see the jungle reserve of the Waimiri-Atroari Indian tribe.

Next Saturday, he will visit the city of Lidice in the interior of Rio de Janeiro state, named after the Czech town that was destroyed by the Nazis in the Second World War in retaliation for a Czech partisan attack on a German general.

Havel leaves Brazil on Sept. 21 and head for Chile. He will a;sp visit Argentina and Uruguay before briefly returning to Brazil for some sight-seeing at the spectacular Foz de Iguacu waterfalls. He returns to Prague on Sept. 28.
